title: Government Of India Act 1935
definition: The Government of India Act 1935 was the longest and most complex piece of British legislation for India, providing a framework for an All-India Federation and provincial autonomy, serving as the primary blueprint for the Constitution of India.
importanceInUpsc: It is the most significant constitutional precursor to the Indian Constitution; questions frequently focus on the division of powers, the federal structure, and the transition from dyarchy to provincial autonomy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Government Of India Act 1935.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
